title: The Admitting the Page Was Hard
youtube_title: The Admitting the Page Was Hard | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Trying the smallest brave step still counts.
summary: At a bakery counter facing the street, Sora feels shy about admitting a page was hard and still wanting to try one sentence. Instead of pretending not to care, Sora tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while the ferryman stays kind and does not push for a show.
